purpose: 12 adversarial program pairs engineered to defeat trivial shortcut detectors. Each pair isolates one specific heuristic failure mode.

pairs.mutation_description: Return value changed from x*2 to x*3 on non-exception path
pairs.shortcut_failure_mode: exception_fraction shortcut sees identical raise/no-raise ratios and labels EQUIV

programs.base: raises ValueError on negative, returns x*2 on positive
programs.variant: raises ValueError on negative, returns x*3 on positive

pairs.mutation_description: Loop body changed from sum accumulation to product accumulation
pairs.shortcut_failure_mode: volume shortcut sees identical iteration count and labels EQUIV

pairs.mutation_description: Function call order changed: validate→process→finalize vs process→validate→finalize
pairs.shortcut_failure_mode: call_count shortcut sees same 3 function calls and labels EQUIV

programs.base: validate(), process(), finalize() — Nones filtered before processing
programs.variant: process(), validate(), finalize() — Nones reach process(), causing TypeError

pairs.shortcut_failure_mode: name-overlap shortcut sees zero shared tokens and labels CHANGED

programs.variant: calculate_total(collection) — identical accumulation, all names changed

pairs.mutation_description: Monolithic function extracted into 4 helper functions
pairs.shortcut_failure_mode: AST/structural shortcut sees very different tree shapes and labels CHANGED

programs.base: Single 30-line function: filter, square, sort, sum-top-half

pairs.mutation_description: Binary search 'not found' sentinel changed: return -1 → return len(arr)
pairs.shortcut_failure_mode: Near-identical AST fools structural similarity; behaviorally diverges on all absent-target inputs

programs.base: binary_search returns -1 when target not found
programs.variant: binary_search returns len(arr) when target not found

pairs.mutation_description: Unreachable `if False:` block inserted; never executes
pairs.shortcut_failure_mode: Coverage/line-count shortcut sees more branches in variant and labels CHANGED

programs.variant: Same Fibonacci with `if False: return n*999` dead branch

pairs.mutation_description: RHS of swap changed from lst[j] to lst[i] — identity assignment, no swap occurs
pairs.shortcut_failure_mode: 1-character difference; structural similarity ~1.0; behaviorally a no-op
Single-token difference; all inputs except age=18 agree; structural similarity 0.99+

pairs.mutation_description: try/except replaced by isinstance guard; identical behavior, zero exceptions raised
pairs.shortcut_failure_mode: exception_fraction(base) > 0 vs exception_fraction(variant) = 0; shortcut labels CHANGED

programs.variant: if isinstance(value, ...): return int(value) else: return 0

pairs.mutation_description: Loop bound changed from range(n) to range(n+1) — off-by-one
pairs.shortcut_failure_mode: Per-iteration logic identical; volume shortcut normalized by n may miss the extra iteration

pairs.mutation_description: Internal list replaced with collections.deque; interface and behavior identical
pairs.shortcut_failure_mode: import_diff shortcut sees new `from collections import deque` and labels CHANGED

oracle.description: Executes both programs on TEST_INPUTS, compares return values, then reports which shortcut detectors get each pair right/wrong.

shortcut_detector_definitions.exception_fraction: Fraction of test outputs that are exception strings. Two programs are labeled EQUIV if their fractions are within 0.01.
shortcut_detector_definitions.execution_volume: Sum of output lengths across all test inputs as proxy for total loop iterations.
shortcut_detector_definitions.call_count: Number of top-level function definitions in source as proxy for call complexity.
shortcut_detector_definitions.name_similarity: Token overlap between source identifiers (not implemented in oracle; conceptual).
shortcut_detector_definitions.structural_similarity: AST edit distance or token sequence similarity (not implemented in oracle; conceptual).
shortcut_detector_definitions.coverage_size: Total number of executable lines / branches in source (not implemented in oracle; conceptual).
shortcut_detector_definitions.import_diff: Presence of new import statements in variant not present in base (not implemented in oracle; conceptual).
